ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white/off-white) and 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white lobes bifurcated by a dark, vertical central band originating from the peduncle. Dark pigment is saturated along the trailing edge border and at both distal tips. Sparse, low-intensity circular clusters (mottling) are present in the interior white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 80-degree V-shaped notch at the central convergence of the lobes, with a moderate indentation depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-amplitude serrations. The left lobe exhibits deep, jagged indentations and sharp peaks. The right lobe shows more frequent but slightly lower-amplitude peaks along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the upper trailing edge, terminating in sharp, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity circular clusters detected: a grouping of three distinct spots in the upper-left interior quadrant and one prominent dark focal spot in the mid-right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on both lobes, including a set of parallel diagonal lines on the lower right quadrant and single thin strokes on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular jagged gouges on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggest significant tissue trauma; extensive linear rake-mark scarring is distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical trailing edge serration profile, with markedly deeper and more irregular tissue indentations on the left lobe compared to the right.
